description: This file implements an EncryptionService in Go that provides methods for encrypting and decrypting sensitive configuration values using AES-GCM encryption, along with functions to encrypt and decrypt specific configuration fields.

classes.name: EncryptionService
classes.description: Provides encryption and decryption for sensitive configuration values using AES-GCM.

methods.name: NewEncryptionService
methods.description: Creates a new EncryptionService instance with a key derived from a passphrase using SHA-256.

methods.name: Encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a plaintext string and returns a base64-encoded ciphertext.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a base64-encoded ciphertext and returns the plaintext.

methods.name: EncryptConfigurationValues
methods.description: Encrypts specified secret fields within a configuration map.

methods.name: DecryptConfigurationValues
methods.description: Decrypts specified secret fields within a configuration map.
